description: This file defines interfaces and classes for Widevine DRM platform integration, including a mock Cdm class, and the WidevinePlatformDRM class for handling decryption operations and handle conversions.

classes.name: widevine::Cdm
classes.description: A mock class representing the Widevine Content Decryption Module with status codes, buffer structures, and decrypt methods.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class providing an interface to initialize, terminate, and perform decryption operations with handle conversion for Widevine DRM.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DRM with a given Cdm pointer.

methods.name: decryptWithHandle
methods.description: Performs decryption by converting a secure handle and calling the Widevine CDM decrypt method.
